propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800-line complexity threshold with mixed concerns: file loading, unknown-field preservation, tempfile cleanup, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, retired-state replacement, and alert persistence co-located with identity policy
extracting persistence logic without byte-preserving contracts risks silent data loss of recoverable partial states
a private BindingRepository unit-of-work must own paths and original dictionaries, return typed views, and preserve load/save byte and exception contracts while BindingStore facade remains unchanged
rotation-before-live ordering, retired-first move ordering, exact sorted/indented/newline serialization, and alert best-effort writes must be preserved across refactoring
the tickets publication seam in reconcile_helpers.py remains external to the repository and must stage only five allowlisted files with no checkpoint publishes
the binding-lifecycle ADR must document repository durability, ordered partial-state recovery, recovery boundaries, and rejection of format migration or journal approaches
